# Security Requirements Checklist: Categories

**Purpose**: Validate that ownership, isolation and integrity requirements for user categories are complete, unambiguous and verifiable
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/categories.openapi.yaml](../contracts/categories.openapi.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Ownership & Isolation

- [ ] CHK001 Is "ownership enforced in every query" stated precisely enough that a reviewer can reject a router-only check? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the "not found for another user's id" rule applied to every endpoint that takes an id, including update and delete? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the seeded defaults required to be owned rows, so no shared or global row can leak between users? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the cascade on user deletion an explicit requirement of this feature, including how it is verified in tests? [Completeness, plan.md R3]

## Input Validation & Integrity

- [ ] CHK005 Are the bounds for `name` (1-50 after trim) and `budget` (≥ 0, 2 decimals) stated in the requirements and not only in the data model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Is `type` constrained at the database level as well as in validation, so a bad write cannot bypass the API? [Gap, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the uniqueness rule defined as database-enforced, so concurrent creates cannot both succeed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the behaviour for a path id of 0, a negative id or a non-integer id specified with the status code expected? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Deferred Guards

- [ ] CHK009 Are FR-006 and FR-008 clearly marked as delivered by the transactions feature, with the interim behaviour (unconditional type change and delete) stated? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications Q2]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the data-loss window created by deferring FR-008 acknowledged as acceptable while no transactions table exists? [Assumption]

## Logging

- [ ] CHK011 Is there a logging requirement for create and delete, or is its absence intentional? [Gap, plan.md]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
